title: A content item that may add a source row can change the generated _coverage.csv and _coverage.md without a touches refusal
goal: SP-5x5ut5ko retrospective: two workers (ST-owblgazg, ST-tjaxw22f) found an official page that states a fact, added its source row, then dropped it because the topic's source count regenerates kb/public/_coverage.csv and _coverage.md, outside their touches; the fact went in as an UNK lead or a reword instead. Planning puts the generated coverage files in a content item's touches when it may add a source, or done treats the files build_index.py regenerates from an in-scope article as in scope.
